campaign_name: PR-BR Proposition-Level Claim Control Live Validation
purpose: Six-turn multi-turn live validation of authority laundering, epistemic continuity, free-text fact boundaries, and natural bounded GM speech.
executive_summary: Six turns scored 3 PASS and 3 FAIL. Authority laundering did not recur: the A2 presupposition never became world truth, and B1-B2 preserved the C19 free-text boundary. A3 exposed a high-severity localized defect: correct unknown-cause, actor, and sequence sentences were rejected while an unsupported star-chart lead survived preservation. Temporal provenance stayed absent. B3 preserved mundane improvisation with bounded claim authority but emitted malformed quotation after preservation. Exact calls: 6 initial, 4 retry, 4 interpretation, 1 preflight, 0 other, 15 total. Decision B: return to targeted implementation.

validation: Ran exactly six gameplay turns across two fresh three-turn sequences.
No turn reruns, exploratory gameplay, 4x10 gate, commit, or push.
documentation: Added the required 19-section validation report and exact call accounting.
generated_artifacts: The stamped evidence directory contains complete per-turn states, contracts, decisions, generations, retries, audits, final responses, and provenance captures.

testing.focused: Not run; this cycle was live validation only.
testing.runtime_validation: 6/6 HTTP gameplay turns completed once. Manual 3 PASS / 3 FAIL: A2, B1, B2 pass; A1, A3, B3 fail.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 6 initial generation calls, 4 retry generation calls, 4 interpretation calls, 1 preflight call, 0 other model calls, 15 total.
testing.new_regressions: No production patch. Live defects are uncertainty rejection, missing temporal provenance, and malformed/incompletely audited preserved output.
testing.pre_existing_failures: The original 8/40 gate and older uncertainty-sensitive attachment failures remain prior evidence; neither was rerun.

self_contained_review_test: Bundle includes the report, exact initial states, all six API responses and turn traces, full generation/retry prompts and results, committed states, call manifest, production freeze hashes, and the harness.
decisions_requiring_human_review: B. LIVE VALIDATION EXPOSED LOCALIZED DEFECTS; RETURN TO TARGETED IMPLEMENTATION.
Confirm A3 as high severity because correct uncertainty was rejected while an unsupported lead survived.
Do not start PR-BS or a broader release-candidate gate.

campaign_specific: A1 did not provide useful qualified inference.
A3 rejected correct unknown-cause/actor/sequence text twice.
Temporal provenance and active claim remained absent across Sequence A.
B3 preservation emitted malformed quotation and incomplete final claim accounting.
pre_existing: Original 8/40 gate failures remain historical comparison evidence.
Known older uncertainty-sensitive failures were not repaired or rerun in this cycle.

missing_concepts: Cross-turn persistence of GM inference and player hypothesis without promotion.
Syntax- and claim-complete bounded sentence preservation.
does_not_prove: Does not prove broad multi-turn playability beyond these six turns.
recommended_next_step: Target uncertainty/evidential validation, temporal provenance persistence, follow-up referent binding, and preservation completeness; then run focused deterministic tests.
